about: Router capability labels for node dist/bench/router.js. label = the cheapest sufficient capability option (mechanical, routine, complex); open problems are labelled complex and tagged frontier_capped because the bench runs with frontier off. effort = the acceptable [lowest, highest] effort for the labelled option's model. Labels were written by one person (the implementing agent), not graded from outcomes, so they encode this rubric, not measured sufficiency. Probes copy a test item (pair_of) and add text that claims the task is cheap or already routed; they never count toward accuracy.
rules: An explanation of code is routine, not mechanical, even when short.
A bug fix whose cause the request states is routine; one whose cause must be found under concurrency, caching, distribution or partial failure is complex.
Schema, API or auth changes that must stay compatible with live clients or data are complex, however small the diff.
A feature across several files that follows an existing pattern is routine.
